name: Squarespace
tagline: Drag-and-drop website builder with templates, ecommerce, and hosting
verdictSummary: If you can build a Next.js site — which you're doing right now — you've already replaced Squarespace. A static or SSR Next.js site deployed to Vercel with a CMS (Contentful, Sanity, or markdown files) is faster, more flexible, and cheaper. Squarespace is a visual editor for people who can't code.
coreLoopDIY: Next.js site with CMS-driven pages, deployed to Vercel
whatYouLose: Drag-and-drop visual editor (irrelevant if you code)
Custom domain management and SSL in one dashboard
moatNotes: Squarespace's moat is non-technical users — if you're reading this site, you're not their target market
whyPeopleStillPay: Non-technical business owners who want a polished site without touching code

priorArt.name: WordPress

notes: This is less 'build a Squarespace clone' and more 'you already have a better solution by knowing Next.js'
